messages:
Anya (PM): Quick poll — we need to recalibrate RICE for the Q3 roadmap. Customers have been loud about Dedicated Integrations and Predictive Cache. Limited eng cycles. I’m proposing Predictive Cache for the coming sprint and Dedicated Integrations for the next quarter/deck. Thoughts?
Matt (Eng): Can you drop the latest R/I/C/E numbers? hard to argue without them.
Anya (PM): Sure — roughs from cust calls + eng estimates: `Predictive Cache: Reach=40k monthly users, Impact=3, Confidence=70%, Effort=5 dev-weeks => RICE≈168`.
Anya (PM): `Dedicated Integrations: Reach=6k, Impact=4, Confidence=60%, Effort=10 dev-weeks => RICE≈144`.
Anya (PM): `Hosted perf work (latency tails): Reach=200k, Impact=2, Confidence=80%, Effort=8 dev-weeks => RICE≈400` — raw numbers, but perf is lower impact per request vs new features.
Sarah (DS): Quick note — "Reach" for perf is tricky: it affects many customers but only matters when latency breaches SLO. We should segment by user-facing sessions vs background jobs.
Raj (Revenue): Dedicated Integrations are literally in two enterprise contracts as requirements. If we delay, risk of losing a $600k ARR expansion. That's high impact on churn/expansion.
Oliver (Platform): Dedicated work also needs infra changes (VPC/KMS flow) which increases unknowns. Confidence felt lower than 60% to me until we spike.
Matt (Eng): Predictive Cache is attractive — smaller infra deltas, clear perf wins, and more quantifiable unit-cost savings. Also lower blocker risk.
Anya (PM): Proposed compromise: run a 1-week spike on Dedicated Integrations (reduce uncertainty) while putting Predictive Cache into the next sprint. If spike reduces effort from 10→6, we re-evaluate RICE and can swap.
Raj (Revenue): Agree to spike but we need a go/no-go by next Wed — sales needs a firm timeline for the deals.
Sarah (DS): For Predictive Cache launch criteria: 1) 20% median latency improvement for search flows, 2) regression tests for hallucination/quality on our eval set, 3) dashboards for cache hit rate + billing delta.
Oliver (Platform): Also add rollout safety: canary on 5% orgs + automatic fallback to non-cache path on error.
Matt (Eng): ETA for spike: 4 dev-days + 2 infra days. If spike shows unknowns, we can push full build to next cycle.
Anya (PM): OK — action items: (1) Matt + Oliver to run Dedicated spike (deliverable: updated effort + blockers) — due Tue EOD. (2) Sarah + Matt to draft Predictive Cache alpha acceptance criteria + perf eval — due Wed morning. (3) I’ll update the RICE spreadsheet and send an updated prioritization deck pre all-hands.
prio-bot: Reminder — please add your vote on the RICE sheet: https://redwood.atlassian/boards/RICE-Q3 (poll closes Thu 5pm PT) :calendar: :memo:
Raj (Revenue): +1 to spike + timeline. Sales will pause contract escalation until Tue.
Sarah (DS): +1 for Predictive Cache in sprint provided we get the eval harness ready this week.
Matt (Eng): +1 to proposed path. I’ll drop a short RFC to capture tradeoffs.
Anya (PM): Thanks — if anyone objects to the spike+ship order, speak now or add a comment on the RICE sheet. I’ll call the prioritization sync tomorrow 10am to finalize. :thumbsup:
Oliver (Platform): One last callout — if spike shows infra blocking, we should have a fallback plan to offer customers Dedicated as a professional services path rather than core product in short-term.
Anya (PM): Noted. Scheduling note: sync invite sent. Will drop updated scores after spike results.
Matt (Eng): Minor: please tag owners on the sheet so we don’t get duplicate work.
Anya (PM): Will do. Thanks all.
